items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I still play with two bands. And they don't think I'm too, they don't hold it against me they want me to come and play with them, you see what I'm saying? Gerald Wilson's band and John Clayton, Clayton-Hamilton Band.

ctx.x: What was it like to work in a band that had two leaders?

Oh, well, thank God. Both of those bands, those two leaders, they dig one another, and so there was no problem with that. I know what you‘re saying, but there was no problem with Thad and Mel in New York City. They were, they handled… and this band Clayton-Hamilton, there‘s three leaders in that band, John Clayton, Jeff Clayton…
Oh his brothers also, okay. And then…
